title: Waymo Expands to Canada With 2028 Toronto Robotaxi Launch

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
All-electric driverless vehicles will begin operating on municipal roads in Toronto in the coming days to prepare for a future ride-hailing debut. Waymo aims to start serving public passengers by 2028 and is partnering with Element Fleet Management to facilitate the rollout in the region.

The expansion represents the company's first deployment of its autonomous taxi service in Canada. Initial vehicle activity will focus on laying the groundwork for the transportation network, including mapping the environment and testing navigation before commercial operations commence.
